summary: An isothermal-plus-shear lens with MGE lens-light and MGE source, fit to the F444W COSMOS-Web Ring imaging (extra-galaxy noise scaling applied, 1.8" circular mask, 2813 pixels) using MultiStartProdigy (48 starts x 300 steps), converges to an Einstein radius of 0.80", matching the tangential critical curve and Mercier et al. (2024). The reduced chi-squared of 0.62 shows the model reproduces the ring and residuals are close to noise-like, confirming a good fit rather than the degenerate wide-mass/no-ring basin the default priors can fall into.
